name: BSP Financial Group Limited
summary: BSP Financial Group Limited provides commercial banking and financial services in Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Cook Islands, Tonga, Samoa, Vanuatu, Cambodia, and Laos. It offers personal banking services, such as saving accounts and term deposits; personal, education, and personal asset loans; and life, health, and mortgage insurance products.
